newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: ABSA secures $160 million three-year loan.
newsitem.headline: ABSA secures $160 million three-year loan.

text.p: South Africa's Amalgamated Banks of South Africa Ltd (Absa) said on Friday it had concluded a $160 million three-year offshore loan at 37.5 basis points over Libor.
ABSA said in a statement the loan was arranged by a number of banks comprising Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi Ltd, Chase Investment Bank, Credit Suisse First Boston, ING Barings and Sakura Bank.
It said the loan would be used for general corporate purposes.
Eric Hirsh, divisional head of financial institutions, said ABSA originally mandated its partners to raise $125 million but this was heavily oversubscribed.
"The $125 million offer...(drew) responses in excess of $200 million of which we decided to take $160 million," Hirsh said.
He said the enthusiastic response showed there was still a good appetite for South African banks at the right price and maturity in the offshore market.
